newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up on gains by weighted issues.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up on gains by weighted issues.

text.p: Dhaka stocks edged up mostly on gains by some weighted scrips, brokers said.
"Investors booked profit on food and financial scrips but gains by Beximco Pharma and some other weighted shares had a positive impact on the index," said one broker.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index rose 8.51 points or 0.51 percent up at 1,663.53 on a tunrover of 122.9 million taka.
Beximco Pharma gained 15.16 taka to 163.10, Bata Shoe rose 7.19 to 222.65 and leasing share IDLC lost 114.17 to 4,755.
